value.message: Town of Oakville has Preschool Levels A-E, and their site says fall registration opened Aug 11 at 7am. YMCA of Oakville has ages 3-5, and Making Waves has Little Waves for 2-5 at $33.13 a lesson, per their sites. I could not get into their pages today for days, times or other prices, and I'll keep watching and text you when I have them.
